source.title: Appointment of Executive Assistants (April 2019)
source.content:
We are happy to announce that the WCA Board has appointed two new Executive Assistants: Daniel James and Thaynara Santana de Oliveira.

They have been selected among the 7 applicants because of their proven skills and trustworthiness serving through the years in different Staff positions.

We wish Daniel and Thaynara the best of luck in fulfilling their new duties!

translation.title: 执行助理任命公告（2019 年 4 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴地宣布，WCA 董事会已任命两位新执行助理：Daniel James 和 Thaynara Santana de Oliveira。

两人在多年担任不同工作人员职务期间，展现了出色的能力，也赢得了信任，因此从 7 位申请人中获选。

祝 Daniel 和 Thaynara 履新顺利！
